title: Advancing men’s health and social connection
discussion_signal: The post frames loneliness and social disconnection, especially among men and younger men, as a public-health issue requiring action beyond the health sector. It links connection to gender, community, and institutional coordination rather than treating loneliness as an individual failure.
linked_research_question: How do gender, community infrastructure, and public institutions shape social connection and unequal exposure to loneliness?
limits: Event announcement and professional dialogue framing
No prevalence or outcome data is presented in the post
